build_send_to_device: build a function that recursively sends nested tensors in lists, tuples, or dicts to a given device
create_gather_tensors: create a function that recursively gathers tensors from all distributed devices into a single structure
test_broadcast_operation: test the broadcast function that recursively broadcasts tensors from one process to all others
refactor_reduce_across_processes: refactor the reduce function to recursively reduce tensors across all processes with mean, sum, or none reduction
review_pad_across_processes: review the pad_across_processes function that recursively pads tensors from all devices to the same size for safe gathering
